title: SMOK V8-T6 Sextuple TFV8 Coils
description: Replacement coils for the Smok TFV8 Cloud Beast tank. The V8-T6 is a supercharged coil head that contains a sextuple build that powers the TFV8 tank. It's a beast and packs quite the punch, promising to deliver big dense vapour and plenty of flavour. These coils work best when used between 110 and 150 Watts.
